Mahanadi Steel Corporation 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Tamil Nadu · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/10/2024/009 
 Dated: 2026-03-31 
 
 Certificate of Completion of Work 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "WTP Augmentation - Tamil Nadu Pkg-9" (water treatment), awarded
 to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been
 completed in all respects on 2024-04-17 at a gross executed value of INR 11,32,00,000/- (Rupees 11.32
 Crore Only). 
 
 On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the
 workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Meera Chatterjee. This certificate is issued for record
 and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Mahanadi Steel Corporation
